_about: Starting visual directions. Each look = palette (bg/fg/accent), a system-safe type stack, and a motion personality. Fonts are system stacks so renders work offline; for brand-exact type, ship the font file and override font. Every palette was checked with scripts/palette.mjs (text >= 4.5:1, accent >= 3:1).

motion.cut: slow dissolve or push, no hard cuts

swiss-minimal.name: Swiss Minimal
swiss-minimal.good_for: B2B/SaaS, data, finance, infrastructure, anything that must feel trustworthy

motion.cut: hard cuts on the beat, no overshoot

night-cinema.name: Night Cinema
night-cinema.good_for: trailers, hardware, automotive, film, anything that needs gravity

motion.cut: long holds, slow push-in, cut on a sound hit

bold-launch.name: Bold Launch
bold-launch.good_for: product launches, app features, startup announcements, social ads

motion.cut: hard cuts on the beat, one orchestrated moment per shot

playful-pop.name: Playful Pop
playful-pop.good_for: consumer apps, kids, community, casual social content

motion.cut: quick cuts, squash and stretch, overshoot on shapes (never on text)

tech-mono.name: Tech Mono
tech-mono.good_for: developer tools, APIs, CLIs, security, changelogs

motion.cut: hard cuts, typewriter or stepped reveals, no easing flourish

luxe-black-gold.name: Luxe Black & Gold
luxe-black-gold.good_for: luxury, fashion, jewellery, high-end hospitality, awards

motion.cut: dissolves and slow fades, almost nothing moves at once

warm-craft.name: Warm Craft
warm-craft.good_for: food, coffee, makers, local business, sustainability, education

motion.cut: soft cuts, slight overshoot on shapes, organic drift
